description: Returns current toll rates for SR 99, SR 167, I-405, SR 509, and SR 520. Filter to one facility with stateRoute ("SR 520", "520", "I-405", or "405") and use offset/limit to page through matches. Each row keeps the feed's bare route number ("099", "405"). On SR 99, SR 509, and SR 520, an unambiguous pair $2 apart gets inferred Good To Go and Pay By Mail labels. SR 99 and SR 520 prices apply in both directions, while SR 509 prices can differ by direction.

limit.description: Maximum toll rates to return in this page. Defaults to 50; a larger value returns at most 500 and says so.

offset.description: Zero-based index of the first toll rate to return, for paging. Defaults to 0.

stateRoute.description: Tolled route to filter by. Accepts natural forms — "SR 520", "520", "0520", "I-405", "405" — matched case- and space-insensitively against each row's posted designation, so a route-type prefix must agree: "SR 405" matches nothing because the I-405 Express Lanes are an Interstate. A route with no tolled facility returns an empty page whose notice names the tolled routes. Omit to include every facility.

name: wsdot_get_toll_rates

appliedFilters.description: Active filters applied to the toll rates. Absent when no filter was applied.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `api_unavailable`: WSDOT Traffic API is unreachable or returns a non-2xx response after retries. `invalid_access_code`: WSDOT rejected the request because WSDOT_ACCESS_CODE is missing, invalid, or not registered. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

hasMore.description: True when more toll rates remain beyond the current page.

nextOffset.description: Offset to pass to retrieve the next page, or null when this is the last page.

notice.description: Page window and any bidirectional pricing note, or guidance when no data is available, the route has no tolled facility, or the offset ran past the end. Ends with the applied limit when a larger one was clamped.

rates.description: Current toll rates for the matching tolled facilities.

items.description: Current toll rate for one segment or trip.

endLatitude.description: Latitude of the segment end point.

endLocationName.description: Feed label for the ending endpoint.

endLongitude.description: Longitude of the segment end point.

endMilepost.description: Ending milepost as reported by the feed.

inferredPaymentMethod.description: Payment method inferred for SR 99, SR 509, or SR 520 when two rates for the same span differ by exactly $2. Good To Go is the lower rate and Pay By Mail is the higher rate. Omitted when no unambiguous pair exists.

message.description: Dynamic message associated with this toll.

startLatitude.description: Latitude of the segment start point.

startLocationName.description: Feed label for the starting endpoint.

startLongitude.description: Longitude of the segment start point.

startMilepost.description: Starting milepost as reported by the feed.

stateRoute.description: Route number as the feed reports it: bare and zero-padded, with no route type ("099", "405"). The rendered text shows the posted designation (SR 99, I-405).

timeUpdated.description: When this toll rate was last updated (ISO 8601).

tollRateInDollars.description: Current toll rate in US dollars.

travelDirection.description: Raw direction code the feed assigns the toll trip: N, S, E, or W. SR 99, SR 509, and SR 520 each carry one fixed code (S, S, and E). SR 99 and SR 520 rates apply in both directions. On SR 509 the ordered mileposts distinguish the directions.

tripName.description: Name of the tolled trip or lane segment.

totalCount.description: Total toll rate entries matching the filter across all pages (not just this page).

title: Get Toll Rates
